senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; חוּל, חלל; cmp. מְחִילָּה)wady, river-bed, ravine, stream.
units: Sabb. 56ᵇ (ref. to I Sam. XV, 5) על עסקי נ׳ (he was discussing) the subject of naḥal (Deut. XXI, 4), i.e. the regard due to human lives.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:2:8">Cant. R. to I, 2</cite> <he>עד שנעשה כנ׳ נובע</he> until he (through his erudition) becomes like a bubbling stream; a. e.—Pl. <he>נְחָלִים</he>, <he>נְחָלִין</he>.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:2:8">Ib.</cite> <he>מה מים … ונעשין נ׳ נ׳</he> as waters come down in drops and grow to be torrents; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 1:16">Midr. Till. to Ps. I. Ber. 1</cite><cite ref="Berakhot 16a:1">Ber. 16ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Numbers 24:6">Num. XXIV, 6</cite>) <he>מה נ׳ … אף אהלים וכ׳</he> as the waters of streams raise man from uncleanness to cleanness, so do the tents (of learning) &c.; a. fr.
